text:
Cara (partnerships): Quick sync — AWS Marketplace webinar is 2026-04-08 11:00 PT. Need to lock speakers, demo flow (live vs pre-record), booth staffing times, and swag counts by EOD Friday. @Nina can you confirm marketplace co-branding rules?

Evan (marketing): Got it. I can own the slide deck and registration page. For swag, proposing 400 stickers, 150 polos, 300 one-pagers. Budget OK pending final headcount.

Ravi (solutions): I can do the live demo (15m) showing model routing and autoscale. Recommend a 3m prerecorded fallback in case latency spikes. Need access to a dedicated pool for the rehearsal.

Jun (eng): For the rehearsal/demo we'd prefer a stable endpoint — please use the dedicated tenant we talked about. Quick start command to spin up the demo env: `ri serve --model redwood-3b-quant --dedicated-pool demo-pool --port 8080` — I'll provide a mini-runbook for the on-stage switch.

Nina (aws_pm): Co-branding sounds fine. Small ask: marketplace listing screenshot + approved logo lockups in the deck. Also confirm we mention "available on AWS Marketplace" verbatim. Shipping deadline for co-branded polos: 2026-03-30.

Cara (partnerships): Thanks. Action items: 1) Evan — slide deck + registration by Wed 3/25; 2) Ravi/Jun — rehearsal on 4/06 10:00 PT; 3) Nina — send logo assets + copy approval by 3/24; 4) Evan — finalize swag counts and shipping address by 3/30.

Evan (marketing): Deck link: https://drive.redwood/example/aws-webinar-deck (will share access). Registration draft is up at https://events.redwood/example — please review. Swag: adjusting to 350 stickers / 120 polos / 250 one-pagers to fit budget.

Ravi (solutions): Rehearsal confirmed 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. I'll prepare a ~7-step demo script (live->fallback). Quick excerpt: `1) Start inference, 2) Show prefix caching, 3) Switch model variant to cost tier, 4) simulate failover to fallback` — will paste full script in the rehearsal doc.

Jun (eng): Rehearsal runbook here: https://confluence.redwood/demo-runbook-aws (includes rollback steps and the `ri serve` commands). I'll be on standby for stage cutover.

calendar-bot: Event scheduled: "Redwood x AWS - Marketplace Webinar" on 2026-04-08 11:00 PT. Rehearsal: 2026-04-06 10:00 PT.

Cara (partnerships): Perfect. One last ask — booth staffing: can we have two engineers + one AE for the booth window 10:00-14:00 PT? Also want a small sign explaining "How we keep inference predictable & cheap".

Evan (marketing): Booth staffing noted. I'll order a tabletop sign and bring flyers. Shipping address for polos/stickers: Redwood HQ Events, 120 Market St, SF. Deadline 3/30 per Nina.

Nina (aws_pm): Confirmed on co-branding copy: please use the exact phrase "Available via Amazon Web Services Marketplace". Logo files uploaded to the folder Nina/aws-assets.

Cara (partnerships): Great teamwork — I'll compile the run-of-show and circulate by EOD tomorrow. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:\"
